population.definition: 3640 global-lattice windows (near-equal-area land sample, 220 km spacing)

dimensions.label: Fine-scale slope distribution
dimensions.method: 1-Wasserstein distance between slope CDFs at the target's fine baseline (100 m Moon, 400 m Mars), built from p50/p90 and slope-class fractions; similarity exp(-W1/3 deg)

dimensions.label: Roughness and curvature
dimensions.method: TRI, slope spread and Laplacian-curvature spread at the fine baseline as log ratios (features measured on both sides only: TRI alone at the 400 m Mars baseline); Mahalanobis distance with shrunk Earth-population correlation, normalised by effective dimension

dimensions.label: Regional relief (2 km baseline)
dimensions.method: 2 km-baseline slope p50/p90, fraction < 20 deg, relief and elevation spread; decorrelated distance

dimensions.label: Exposed, unvegetated ground
dimensions.method: WorldCover bare + 0.5 x moss/lichen fraction vs. a target surface with no vegetation

dimensions.label: Lithology class
dimensions.method: Macrostrat map unit at window centre (+ volcano / impact-structure context within 30 km) mapped to a common vocabulary; 0.5 x best class match + 0.5 x mean coverage of the target's literature classes

dimensions.label: Aridity and surface water
dimensions.method: exp(-P/150 mm) x (1 - open-water fraction) vs. targets without liquid precipitation or standing water

dimensions.label: Thermal regime (near-surface air)
dimensions.method: Overlap / distance between Earth monthly 2 m air-temperature range and Mars near-surface air temperature range; the Moon has no air and is handled in the gap ledger

bodies_not_applicable.moon: no atmosphere: lunar surface temperature is not comparable with Earth air temperature; see the gap ledger

dimensions.label: Solar geometry
dimensions.method: Fraction of the target's noon solar-elevation range (latitude, obliquity) that the Earth site reproduces during its year; day length and sky scattering are gap-ledger items

dimensions.label: Mineralogy / spectral composition
dimensions.reason: No spectral product was acquired (EMIT L2B, ASTER, Sentinel-2 for Earth; M3, CRISM, OMEGA for targets). Lithology classes are map/literature categories, not mineral identifications.
dimensions.integration_path: EMIT L2B mineral identification via NASA Earthdata (login) or Earth Engine; add columns min_* with evidence 'observed (spectral proxy)'.

dimensions.label: Wind, dust and aeolian processes
dimensions.reason: No wind, aerosol or dune dataset acquired (ERA5, MERRA-2, MAIAC AOD; Mars TES dust).
dimensions.integration_path: ERA5-Land wind statistics via Copernicus CDS key; MAIAC AOD via Earth Engine.

bodies_not_applicable.moon: no wind on the Moon; lunar dust transport is electrostatic/impact-driven

dimensions.label: Ice, permafrost and subsurface water
dimensions.reason: No permafrost or ice product acquired (ESA CCI Permafrost; LEND/Mini-RF; SWIM/SHARAD).
dimensions.integration_path: ESA CCI Permafrost (CEDA, open) as fraction of window with permafrost probability.

dimensions.label: Caves, lava tubes and pits
dimensions.reason: No cave or lava-tube inventory acquired for Earth, Moon or Mars.
dimensions.integration_path: Mars Global Cave Candidate Catalog (USGS) and lunar pit catalogues; Earth karst maps.

moon.atmosphere: surface-bounded exosphere (He, Ar, Ne); effectively vacuum

mars.scope: Viking Lander 1 site (body-level reference, not site-specific)

moon.scope: equatorial; polar cold traps reach ~25 K (Paige D.A. et al. 2010, Science 330:479)
lunar far side surface, Chang'e-4 LND
moon.source: Zhang S. et al. (2020) Science Advances 6:eaaz1334

COP_GLO30.basis: Copernicus DEM relative vertical accuracy < 2 m (LE90) for slopes <= 20 %; Copernicus DEM Product Handbook (AIRBUS, 2020)

PGDA_LOLA_5MPP.basis: order of LOLA-adjusted 5 m DEM height residuals; Barker M.K. et al. (2021) PSS 197:105119

USGS_MARS_BLEND.basis: HRSC/MOLA blend of mixed effective resolution; Fergason R.L. et al. (2018) USGS

aggregation:
Ranking: aggregation with uncertainty, Earth-wide percentiles, rarity, novelty, diversity.

Aggregation (identical in web/src/discover/engine.ts; parity-tested):

  per dimension      mu_d = ln s50_d,  sd_d = (ln hi_d - ln lo_d) / (2 * 1.645)
  fidelity           exp( sum_A w_d mu_d / sum_A w_d )   over measured dimensions A
  90 % interval      exp( mu +- 1.645 * sqrt(sum_A w_d^2 sd_d^2) / sum_A w_d )   (independence assumed)
  coverage           sum_A w_d / sum_{applicable} w_d     (not-assessed dimensions count as applicable)
  score              fidelity * coverage                  (default ranking; cannot reach 1 with gaps)
  bounded interval   [lo * coverage, hi * coverage + (1 - coverage)]  (unknown dimensions in [0, 1])

Evidence category
  strong          coverage >= 0.6 and interval width <= 0.35
  weak            otherwise, with coverage >= 0.5
  missing_driven  coverage < 0.5: apparent similarity rests on few measured dimensions

mars.label: body-level, model estimate

rover.name: EGIZ demonstration rover (declared assumption, matches web DEFAULT_DESIGN)

soil.name: Apollo-era lunar soil design estimate (rough; NASA Lunar Surface Data Book)

mars.soil_note: Mars runs reuse the Apollo-era LUNAR soil parameters: Mars regolith Bekker parameters are not measured or estimated here, so Mars slope-limit and sinkage values are lunar soil at Mars gravity
mars.note: Identical for every Earth candidate on this body: depends on gravity, rover and assumed soil only, not on the window's terrain.
limitations: Soil parameters are rough Apollo-era lunar estimates applied to both cases; Jezero and all Earth field soils are unmeasured.
No gravity-dependent soil strength, slip-sinkage, grousers, dynamic loading or multi-pass effects.
Static, quasi-steady, equal wheel loads on a uniform slope; not a mission performance prediction.
